terra.problem: “People brought to Samaria” describes an event in Samaria, not at Sepharvaim.
“Gods of Sepharvaim” describes practices in Samaria, not an event at Sepharvaim.
“The Rabshakeh’s taunt” takes place near Jerusalem, not at Sepharvaim.
“Hezekiah prays over the letter” takes place in Jerusalem, not at Sepharvaim.
